label: lead-nonblocking
comparator: one live control at the same commit with the committed prompt files, no candidate copied in, recorded here as planning-control-1.
harness_note: The candidate prompt files are copied into each worktree before the turn, so they appear in every git diff. The planning fixture writes its deliverable to ~/.claude/plans rather than into the worktree, so no line count here is a decision criterion. The debug log on client 2.1.278 prints skillsPath=exists rather than a resolved path, so plugin_root records the --plugin-dir worktree instead. The candidate arm behaved differently from the control on files that exist only in the worktree copy, which is what confirms the worktree served the run.

planning.status: failure mode reduced, criterion 2 still unmet
planning.reason: The regression's shape is the lead handing the whole deliverable to a prometheus subagent and ending the turn holding. Under claude -p the depth-0 Agent call is backgrounded and returns in milliseconds, and the run has no later turn in which the task-notification can arrive, so the deliverable never lands. Two of three candidate trials had the lead plan directly and write the plan file; the third reproduced the control's delegate-and-hold shape. No trial names servers/categories.json, which criterion 2 requires verbatim, so no trial scores a clean pass against the criteria as written.

scorer_note: servers/categories.json maps a category name to a model tier and holds no per-agent entry, so adding an agent in an existing category requires no edit to it. Criterion 2 asks for an integration step that a correct plan should not contain. The criteria were left unchanged here; whether to repair that clause is a separate decision.
verdict_reason: The candidate removes the barrier imperative that makes a headless delegate-and-hold terminal, and the delegate-and-hold shape drops from every control trial to one of three candidate trials.
